text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races 
together with Daitaku Helios—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's such a classic ryokan!! Just like the 
ones you see on Umastagram!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using the voucher won at the raffle, I had 
come on a hot springs trip with Daitaku 
Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, isn't this way beyond an inn, like 
straight-up a castle!? Trainy, let's take 
a pic!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Give it that princess vibe! I'll be the 
party animal lord!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyy~â

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha, Trainy looks totally 
princess-core☆ Adorbz☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Alright then, let's go scout it out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, shouldn't we rent out the whole inn!? 
Hot spring fest! Am I a genius or what~!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios's spontaneous idea—scouting 
out a location for an onsen festival. This 
trip served that purpose as well.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
First off, gotta be the bath! It's a hot 
spring, after all☆
choice_data_list: Take your time and have a nice long soak.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Slowly...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: How does it feel?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I will!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
K! Then once we make some noise, I'm gonna 
soak in the emo vibes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whew~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Did you do the post-bath thing too, 
Trainy-P? Milk!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's the best part~☆ Practically the 
main event of a public bath!
choice_data_list: Do you go to the public bath often?
Do you go to the public bath often?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's kinda touching, too☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I've got a regular spot! You can make 
friends at a public bath in literally two 
seconds♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of her motive, diving headfirst 
into unfamiliar things with keen 
curiosity... that's one of her charms.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I want milk at the fes too~! A milk 
bath... yeah, probably not!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Like, can't we just get a tap installed?? 
Or at least, like, put in a drink 
dispenser~."
choice_data_list:
There's a thing called a milk tank, you 
know.

There's something called a milk tank, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! That definitely suits you way 
better! Alright, let's line them up on the 
counter—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, I continued guiding 
Daitaku Helios's ideas toward directions 
that were easier to bring to life—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Wait, somehow... It's actually finished!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I knew it! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainy-P~~ Seriously, you're the 
best☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That made it crystal clear! Just confess 
already♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trainy-P, truth is...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —She's an organizer, dontcha know!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You know all the fun stuff this world has 
to offer, don'tcha?! You're a total party 
animal!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You know, ever since I met you, Trainy, 
pretty much everything I've said has been 
coming true.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I was like, "Am I way too good at my 
job~?" buuut...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If you know all the fun stuff, Trainy-P, 
then of course it's gonna be like that!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wha!?!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Riiight~~!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu~, just as I thought! You really are 
the abso-lute best Trainer ever!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
She turns my hype into mega hype, she's 
super smart, cute yet cool, and totally, 
completely wuvs me! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Every day, Trainy applies the ultimate 
filter to make me look super cute!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprisingly good at understanding 
that kinda stuff, y'know? ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Big thanks as always, and lots of love~♪"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, changing the subject, but can 
you actually change the mineral content of 
a hot spring?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fair skin and smooth skin are totally fine 
and all, but wouldn't a hot spring that 
gives you 'gorgeous vibes' be even better?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyy~â

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and 
Daitaku Helios...
